description: This file defines the QuizProgressStore class, which handles the storage and retrieval of quiz progress data locally using shared_preferences. Includes methods for creating instances asynchronously, saving results, and getting saved results.

classes.name: QuizProgressStore
classes.description: Class managing local storage of quiz progress including methods to save and retrieve quiz results.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new instance of QuizProgressStore by obtaining a SharedPreferences instance.

methods.name: saveResult
methods.description: Saves the quiz result, including last score, total questions, and completion status, associated with a quiz ID.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the stored result for a given quiz ID, returns null if no data exists or decoding fails.
